The '''StarViper Mk. II''', also known as the '''StarViper M-2''', was a modification of the earlier [[StarViper-class attack platform/Legends|''StarViper''-class attack platform]]. The design had less firepower than its predecessor, trading its [[Laser cannon/Legends|heavy laser cannons]] for lighter [[Laser/Legends|lasers]] and heavier [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielding]] while also removing the original model's [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] launchers and replacing them with [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]]. However, the increased versatility offered by the ion cannons made the craft popular with [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] groups and other criminal forces, including the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]].

==History==
[[File:StarViperMkII-SWX.png|thumb|left|250px|A StarViper Mk. II in landing configuration.]]
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], multiple criminal organizations made use of the StarViper Mk. II fighter. [[Thweek]], a [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] spy in the employ of [[Teemo/Legends|Teemo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] owned a StarViper Mk. II.<ref name="Thweek">{{FFGXW|set=Guns for Hire Expansion Pack|cardname=Thweek}}</ref> The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], [[Dalan Oberos]], also owned one of the modified StarVipers.<ref name="Dalan Oberos">{{FFGXW|set=Guns for Hire Expansion Pack|cardname=Dalan Oberos}}</ref> [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] were known to fly StarViper Mk. IIs on their missions as well.<ref name="Assassin">{{FFGXW|set=Guns for Hire Expansion Pack|cardname=Black Sun Assassin}}</ref>
